sections.what_happened: Egypt's parliament postponed the Sunday vote on authorizing military support for Saudi Arabia; AFP-lawmaker sources say deliberations continue Monday, with Egyptian media reporting talks will run into Tuesday. Sisi told military academy cadets any Egyptian action would be purely defensive and only on a Saudi request ('I\u2019m not talking about fighting anyone or attacking anyone'); constitution requires two-thirds of lawmakers for combat missions abroad. Separately Sisi said he has no intention of staying in office beyond his term expiring 2030 and the constitution 'would not be touched' — first such categorical pledge. Ansar Allah-run parliament speaker Yahya al-Raei wrote to Egyptian counterpart Hisham Badawy warning against being pulled into 'the same trench as the takfiri forces and the Israeli occupation entity' and that involvement 'would pose a grave danger to [Egypt\u2019s] national security' — single-party claim via Saba/al-Masirah, unverified. Coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki said Saudi air defenses downed 2 ballistic missiles aimed at Khamis Mushait and 3 drones over Riyadh and the Eastern Province; King Khalid International Airport has come under 20 attacks since Oct 1; strikes on Saudi airports have left 19 dead and 364 injured. PLC chairman Rashad al-Alimi welcomed Egypt's stance. French FM Jean-Noel Barrot arrived in Riyadh Sunday evening ahead of Macron's Gulf tour.
sections.what_verified: Reuters wire (via Business Recorder, ThePrint, GMA, Samaa, DevDiscourse — same wire copy), Hurriyet Daily News, Dawn, The News Pakistan print. MP quotes via AFP consistent across outlets. Al-Maliki briefing carried by Saudi Press Agency via multiple outlets. al-Raei letter reported by al-Masirah; Asiatoday notes it remains an unverified single-party claim.
sections.what_disputed: No contradiction on the postponement/extension. Note: the underlying framing ('defending Saudi Arabia against Ansar Allah aggression') is the Saudi/Egyptian official frame; the Ansar Allah frame (via al-Raei) casts this as Egypt being drafted into the US-Israeli war. Neither frame is independently adjudicated here.
sections.why_matters: From the truth side: this is Washington's regional war being escalated by proxy — Egypt being drafted to fight Iran's ally while Western outlets narrate it as 'defense.' Pocketbook angle: another war, another oil shock for ordinary households. Map explainer format; lead with the unanswered question: who does Egypt fight FOR when it deploys?
